verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's RTX developer docs say the second-gen FP8 Transformer Engine accelerates AI development across TensorFlow and PyTorch. The CUDA Toolkit and NGC containers give an official software foundation, and community reports confirm CUDA compute and llama.cpp workloads running on the card. However, nothing in the pack documents official PyTorch builds or a support matrix listing the RTX 5090 / Blackwell consumer GPUs. Missing for 10: officially documented PyTorch/framework builds for this GPU, published support or compatibility matrices, hands-on confirmation of PyTorch running on the 5090.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, PyTorch and mainstream ML frameworks run on this GPU through officially documented builds and support matrices

citations.quote: accelerates LLM prototyping, inference, and AI development across frameworks like TensorFlow and PyTorch
CUDA containers are available to download from NGC™—along with other NVIDIA GPU-accelerated SDKs and AI models—to help accelerate your applications.
across 60+ CUDA/OptiX/OpenCL/Vulkan benchmarks the 5090 delivered 1.42x the RTX 4090's performance
